name: Dear Nont
source:
All of a sudden, you received a letter from a long-lost ex-boyfriend asking you to pick up some stuff from his apartment. How hard could it be? You can just go there, grab your things, and leave.

[from [url=https://pyabmxk.itch.io/dear-nont]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
突然，你收到一封失散多年的前男友的来信，要求你去他的公寓取一些东西。这有多难？你可以去那里，拿上你的东西，然后离开。

[来自[url=https://pyabmxk.itch.io/dear-nont]itch.io[/url]]
